Muninn has no decision or standing rule about versioning. Its only versioning entries are two one-word chat remarks ("calver", then "semver"), each at trust level 1 (seen in a transcript, not confirmed by a commit or exit code). Neither had a task attached, and only the "semver" reply, an assistant's paraphrase, treated it as replacing the earlier one. Muninn's own answer to "why this scheme" was "insufficient". I didn't treat those remarks as a decision, so I left both schemes out of the file.

If semver is the intended choice, tell me and I'll update the file.
